q: Why must the patient stay completely still while the robot is docked?
o: Movement can cause injury from the fixed instruments
why: The robot's instruments are fixed in the abdomen; any movement risks injury.

q: What should the team rehearse for robotic surgery?
why: You can't reach the patient for CPR until the robot is undocked.

q: Which effect does steep head-down have?
o: Raised ICP and IOP and facial and airway oedema
why: Check for airway oedema before extubation.

q: How is rocuronium usually reversed at the end of robotic surgery?
why: Deep block is common, so sugammadex is often used.
